entities.name: Gastal
entities.description: An apocalyptic wasteland plane of gas, dragonic warlords and road warriors, home of the Endriders and the scorpion dragon Akul.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: A ferocious scorpion dragon of Gastal who traveled to Thunder Junction and formed the Hellspurs.

entities.name: Endriders
entities.description: Raiding gangs of Gastal; one gang formed a racing team on Avishkar.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who attended a meeting on Gastal seeking Phyrexia's origin.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Accompanied Urza to the meeting on Gastal.

entities.name: Manatarqua
entities.description: Planeswalker killed at the meeting on Gastal.

entities.name: Far Fortune
entities.description: Led an Endrider gang stranded on Avishkar.

entities.name: Hellspurs
entities.description: Gang formed by Akul on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Plane where Far Fortune's gang was stranded.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths that connected planes to the Multiverse in 4562 AR.

events.summary: A meeting of planeswalkers on Gastal was interrupted by an unseen attack, killing Manatarqua; Urza abandoned his plans there.
The Omenpaths opened, and Endrider gangs fled Gastal.
events.quote: Endrider gangs and other inhabitants fled the plane looking for planes for food, water, and easier raiding.

events.summary: Akul traveled to Thunder Junction and formed the Hellspurs.
events.quote: The scorpion dragon Akul to traveled to Thunder Junction and formed The Hellspurs .

events.summary: Far Fortune's stranded gang formed the Endriders racing team at the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
events.quote: Far Fortune and her crew found their way to the Ghirapur Grand Prix and formed the Endriders racing team.

relations.quote: One gang, led by Far Fortune , ended up stranded on Avishkar.
It the home of the Endriders and the ferocious scorpion dragon Akul .
